set.st: Three men robbed the Wabeno State Bank of $32,000 in cash and negotiable securities on 15 July 1921 (first put at $27,000). Willis and Lawrence Lesperance and Chalmer Yaeger were caught at Chippewa Falls in August and got 25 years each at Crandon. By their confession they buried the loot in the woods some distance from Wabeno while posses were on their trail. In July 1922 Lawrence was brought from Waupun for a day-long search that found nothing. In August 1922 berry pickers found a weather-beaten touring car on an abandoned logging trail in the wilderness about 20 miles east of Wabeno, several miles west of Athelstane, and the search moved there. Pin is approximate (town or township only), not the spot itself.
